execution_mode.claim: The stored JANUS component contracts were gathered and applied as one research/search contour. No unexecuted local CLI or GitHub Actions workflow is represented as having run.

objective: Use the complete JANUS reasoning/search grammar to reduce the search space for a genuinely prospective, independently replayable FIRST_FUTURE_BREAK result in public viral data while preserving failure, ambiguity, contamination and prior art.

janus_contour.role: Expand source-addressable candidate graph across viral trajectory, cell-fate, regeneration and evidence-governance domains.
Walk backward from later fate to earliest independently supported transition; remove semantic strengthening unsupported by source lineage.
FORWARD/BACK/LEFT/RIGHT plus abstraction scale and time-identity-provenance rotation.
Use deterministic suspect-blind per-record receipts; forbid names/titles/semantic similarity as independent support; preserve all negatives before recurrence aggregation.
Transfer only previously held-out-surviving internal patterns: NON_TRANSITIVE_EVIDENCE_BINDING_LADDER, AMBIGUITY_IS_A_FIRST_CLASS_STATE, FIRST_BREAK_LOCALIZATION.
Generate contrast pairs, champion/anti-champion structures and third mechanisms; relation remains hypothesis until independent replay.
Retrieve structurally similar exact episodes and rank next routes without granting theorem/scientific authority.
Record search debt, failure and calibration regressions; fresh stage before learning; rollback/widen after regression.
Mine relations, prior art, counterexamples and new test targets.
Represent branch futures; allow state merging only when future equivalence is certified under the declared interface.
Attack collisions, boundary certificates, stale memory, cross-language joins, false merges and OPEN-to-negative promotion.
Audit complete pre-outcome information, common causes, d-separation, selection, optional stopping, multiplicity and continuity before accepting independent evidence.
Authority layer for frozen score, holdout, nulls, provenance and terminal PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN.

killed_as_novel: generic early-warning/tipping-point prediction of cell fate
prior_art_killer_result.survivor: CERTIFIED_FUTURE_BREAK_STACK is retained only as a JANUS search/validation architecture, not established scientific novelty.

derived_search_architecture.name: CERTIFIED_FUTURE_BREAK_STACK
derived_search_architecture.principle: The target is not the earliest detectable changepoint. The target is the earliest evidence-bound interval at which a frozen local representation adds out-of-sample information about future fate, with no automatic promotion across evidence levels.
derived_search_architecture.ambiguity_law: If the evidence does not identify a unique causal/state binding, preserve a candidate set or UNKNOWN.
derived_search_architecture.future_equivalence_law: Two present states may merge only if their declared correctness-relevant future behavior is certified equivalent.

external_transport_calibration.paper: Single-phage profiling illuminates viral individuality during bacterial cell fate determination
calibration_observations: Cell-state population remains near an early attractor until about 15 minutes then diverges toward lytic and lysogenic attractors.
Replication-deficient P-minus infection can occupy a transient failed-lytic state, contrasting with later irreversible-looking commitment in wild-type P-plus data.
Individual phage profiles and whole-cell fate are non-identical evidence levels.
The authors explicitly state that the data do not identify the direction of causality between phage unanimity and lysogenization.

trajectory_calibration_frontier.use: Validate changepoint/FFB estimators and null behavior without making novelty claims.
